intro: Quae has gone through the folder and learned that Apothecary Jorell is running deadly experiments at Go'Shek Farm. Quae is in poor shape after clashing with orcs and cannot help Kinelory, who will need your protection when she heads for the farm to steal any of Jorell's research not yet sent to Tarren Mill.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This IS interesting. Seems Apothecary Jorell has been working on some deadly experiments here at Go'Shek. Not sure what that has to do with Hillsbrad, but Phin wouldn't like it if we let it continue.

We had a run-in with some orcs while you were gone, and I'm not in good enough shape to help Kinelory. If you're up for it, she's going to need some protection when she goes down to the farm to steal whatever research Jorell still hasn't sent to Tarren Mill.

clips.title: Completion
paras: If it brings Phin peace, I'll destroy every single one of the Forsaken personally. He's done so much for us since the plague. We never thought we'd find friends or family again.
When you're prepared, come let me know. We'll get started right away.
